lock_items: Andy confirms the hook wording by ear (medium and large-v3 both hear "Exterior cleaners still got 20 grand a month"; "still got" may be "still at").
The guarantee terms for "20 more jobs completely guaranteed" are written on the landing page.
"All live within just four days" is true for a new client.
Andy accepts or fixes each Meta policy scan item above.
meta_scan: MEDIUM: Hook "still got 20 grand a month" names the viewer's revenue. Meta's personal-attributes rule rejects ads that imply they know the viewer's financial situation. Safer: "Exterior cleaners who want more booked jobs."
MEDIUM: "$20K A MONTH?" on screen is a money figure. Money on screen can read as an income claim.

MEDIUM: "20 more jobs completely guaranteed ... every single month" is a guarantee. It is a jobs guarantee, not income, but the terms ("booked" means what, which conditions) must exist on the landing page.
